segments.name: Gaming
segments.description: A vertically integrated social network for college gaming that lets college students compete, support teams and win prizes.
segments.evidence: The Company and its subsidiaries manage its business activities on a consolidated basis and operate as a single operating segment (the "Gaming" segment).

revenueModel.text: Brands pay the company to reach its Gen Z college gaming audience through sponsored content and prizes.
revenueModel.evidence: Brag House is a mission-driven organization that utilizes a diversified business strategy to operate a media-tech platform designed for casual college gamers to drive community-driven gaming experiences anchored in the college sports culture, while creating authentic pathways for brands to connect with our Gen Z audience.
